branch_semantics: Nearest containing branch checkpoint from the cleanup inventory; not a claim about the original build branch.
build_identity_note: Original build HEAD/branch are not uniformly recorded. Artifact commits authenticate exact image bytes; saved reports and producer snapshots carry the finer build evidence.

audiobook-ay/lpc-probe.description: LPC-based speech approximation using three AY tones and noise; historical listening experiment.

audiobook-ay/music-preview.description: Initial Entertainer music-to-AY conversion; the before-loading-label subdirectory preserves the earlier UI build.

audiobook-ay/pitch-preview.description: Pitch-aware YM2149 speech synthesis, three tone generators and shared noise at interrupt rate.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/audio-conve.description: Generic IMA4 audio-converter fixtures: short speech and silence, including calibration builds.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/audio-dynam.description: Gentle 2:1 source compression and normalization before IMA4 encoding; full five-part disk and individual selected/calibration builds. Playback timing is unchanged; residual cyclic error remains.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/entertainer.description: Peak-normalized Entertainer source, encoded separately as IMA3 and IMA4.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/ima-3bit-di.description: Packed IMA3 decoded directly to packet PDM without expansion to IMA4; automatic bounded encoding/calibration.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/ima-3bit-ov.description: IMA3 waveform search with overlapping windows; accepted speech reference. Series image and its resident first part are both retained.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/ima-3bit-se.description: IMA3 sequential playback: fill available RAM, play, then load the next part; includes multi-disk and silence fixtures.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/ima-3bit-wa.description: Historical three-bit IMA alphabet with waveform-aware PC encoding; this pre-direct experiment expands the packed stream to IMA4 at load time.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/ima-direct-.description: Direct IMA4 PDM experiment with repeat-loop phase locking; includes its separate packet control.
Direct IMA4 experiment with PC voice precompensation; retained comparison, not a new default.
Direct IMA4 feedback/packet timing comparison with weighted contention modelling.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/ima-lpc-pre.description: LPC data on disk, synthesized and encoded into four-bit IMA in Spectrum RAM before the ordinary direct player starts; raw128 is the read-time control.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/ima-quality.description: Shared IMA3/IMA4 host quality search. music/speech names identify the source; selected, pilot, phase calibration, history, CLI and paused paths are distinct stages, not equally accepted releases.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/ima-wavefor.description: Waveform-aware four-bit IMA host search, rebuilt and verified on the candidate clock; includes all saved phase candidates.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/ima4-full-d.description: First 113.712 seconds of speech in five IMA4 parts filling one TRD; original low-gain comparison. Known flutter/quality limitation; stronger normalized successor is separate.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/ima4-overla.description: IMA4 overlapping-window PDM waveform search and its selected/control builds; all extra search work is on the PC.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/loop-debugg.description: Precomputed 8-kHz PCM-to-PDM timing pilot from an interrupted debugger session; interruption alone does not prove a defective disk.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/mulaw-trd.description: Compact eight-bit mu-law source, expanded to amplitude only while generating PDM; qualified baseline converter image.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/mulaw128.description: Eight-bit mu-law packet-PDM 128-kHz study, including 64-kHz control and waveform candidates. Use path and evidence to distinguish each stage.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/pcm-live-fa.description: PCM8 decoded to beeper PDM on the Z80, faster live-conversion alternative.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/pdm64.description: PC-precomputed PDM experiment at the 64-kHz target, including timing pilot.

audiobook-beeper/experiments/quality-max.description: Bounded quality search across direct IMA3, IMA4 and mu-law; per-codec controls, selected streams and candidate stages retained.

audiobook-beeper/ima-preview.description: Early balanced four-bit IMA-to-PDM player, with assembly compiled separately and packaged by Python.

audiobook-beeper/pcm-live-fixed.description: PCM8-to-PDM live player with corrected paging-port addressing.

audiobook-beeper/preview-8k8-loop.description: Looping precomputed PDM from PCM8/8 kHz; archived timing pilot.

audiobook-beeper/preview-8k8.description: Precomputed PDM from PCM8/8 kHz, including the timing pilot.

audiobook-beeper/preview.description: Initial precomputed beeper PDM experiment; timing pilot retained.

ay-converter/analysis/music50.description: Entertainer converted with the 20-ms AY music preset.

ay-converter/analysis/tracked50.description: Entertainer with persistent tonal-component tracking and channel assignment at 50 Hz.

ay-converter/analysis/noise_colour.description: Entertainer with continuous AY chip-model noise fitting.

ay-converter/analysis/o_henry.description: O. Henry source seconds 60..84; unchanged music profile and chip-model noise fit, 1200 AY states. Speech audition awaiting user acceptance.

toolkit/banked_audio_evidence.description: Banked resident AY and CB41 video integration; per-variant fixtures.

toolkit/cb41_10fps_fixture_evidence.description: Generic 10-fps CB41 fixtures, including silence, portrait, colour, aspect ratio and audio-tail cases.

toolkit/cb41_10fps_window_evidence.description: Sustained 256-frame 10-fps window through difficult scenes, rather than a full-movie release.

toolkit/direct_lzsa2_header_evidence.description: CB41 rebuild with direct LZSA2 header handling.

toolkit/early_lzsa2_prefix_evidence.description: Rebuilt streaming LZSA2 player with earlier prefix handling.

toolkit/fixed_audio_tail_evidence.description: Fixed resident AY storage/tail integration with CB41.

toolkit/four_video_slots_evidence.description: Four video-slot RAM allocation with fixed resident AY.

toolkit/front_fast_masks_evidence.description: Front-cell mask optimization on a sustained comparison window.

toolkit/front_native_evidence.description: Front-cell reuse and native renderer integration fixtures.

toolkit/full_volume_dictionary_evidence.description: Full-volume dictionary pressure probe; not a promoted release.

toolkit/generic_cb41_evidence.description: Generic CB41 converter acceptance fixtures, retaining each input case and disk part.

toolkit/generic_guarded_cb46_evidence.description: Opt-in guarded CB46 converter fixtures and full fourth-volume comparison. Full-movie nominal timing is not certified by these fixtures.

toolkit/inline_cells_evidence.description: Rebuilt CB41 player with inline cell dispatch/output comparison.

toolkit/invisible_attributes_evidence.description: Host removal of provably invisible attribute writes, then player rebuild and verification.

toolkit/monochrome_preview_evidence.description: Monochrome 256-frame preview starting at frame 4128, five-level cells at 10 fps.

toolkit/optional_read_gate_evidence.description: Optional read-admission gate in the CB41 player, rebuilt against saved stream.

toolkit/partial_row_evidence.description: Partial-row cell update experiment against saved video/AY input.

toolkit/refined_av_attempt_evidence.description: Passing 64-frame probe from the original refined-AV disk partition study. The failed eight-part set was retired separately.

toolkit/refined_av_movie_evidence.description: Historical fifteen-disk refined colour and AY movie, before the four-disk cached rebuild.

toolkit/refined_four_evidence.description: Current four-disk cached refined-colour movie at 10 fps with 50-Hz AY; full verification accepts fallback timing, not zero late frames.

toolkit/retired_cell_evidence.description: Fixtures for retiring unused reconstruction code/RAM, not retired or rejected disk images.

toolkit/same_cost_compression_evidence.description: Host dictionary numbering/LZSA2 selection constrained by CPU cost, followed by player rebuild.

toolkit/sector_cache_evidence.description: Compressed-sector cache variants rebuilt with saved CB41 input.

toolkit/shared_audio_evidence.description: Shared fixed-resident AY storage and sparse decoder comparison.

toolkit/side_only_seek_evidence.description: Same-cylinder side-selection disk-service experiment on window and full-volume inputs.

toolkit/streaming_bypass_evidence.description: Streaming-bypass player window and full-volume verification; reuse saved CB41 streams.

toolkit/streaming_lzsa2_evidence.description: Streaming/resumable LZSA2 player variants against saved CB41 inputs.

ZX-audiobook-IMA-ADPCM-direct-test.description: Historical direct IMA4 speech disk explicitly preferred by the user. Restored byte for byte for the public YouTube URL; preserve this exact root pathname.

ZX-audiobook-IMA3-compact-tables.description: Direct IMA3 player with reduced lookup-table RAM usage.

ZX-music-Entertainer-IMA3.description: Initial Entertainer IMA3 direct-PDM music audition.

ZX-video-cb41-test.description: Sustained CB41 five-level codebook test, with LZSA2 transport and resident AY.

movie-balanced.description: Complete authorized 4221-frame edit in three disks, five-level CB41/LZSA2 at verified 25/3 fps and unchanged 50-Hz AY.

movie-full.description: Original full movie including credits in fourteen disks, 50-Hz AY and 25/3-fps video. Built, player-rebuilt, packaged and installed as one sequential set.
